sloka: ततः कुम्भनिपातेन जलराशिः समुत्थितः।विन्ध्यमन्दरसङ्काशो विससर्प समन्ततः ।। ६.७६.८५ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kumbhanipātena jalarāśiḥ samutthitaḥ।vindhyamandarasaṅkāśo visasarpa samantataḥ ।। 6.76.85 ।।

translations.english: Then Sugriva lifted Kumbha and threw him into the ocean quickly, to show him the bottom.
